section_summary.extract_value: This section describes two community samples of Zimbabwean women used in the study: 140 women in Harare, Zimbabwe (age M = 25.34, BMI M = 24.81) and 138 Zimbabwean migrant women in London, Britain (age M = 26.61, BMI M = 24.88). The section reports self-reported BMI and ancestral breakdowns (predominantly Shona and Ndebele) but does not report survey method, percent white, education level, body appreciation assessment, or correlations between body appreciation and BMI; no study numbering (e.g., 'Study 1') is provided.
